每個網頁都在搶你的注意力
Every web page is competing for your attention:
彈窗、自動播放、會動的廣告
pop-ups, autoplay videos, moving ads.
對許多人，尤其是神經多樣性的學習者
For many of us, and especially for neurodivergent learners,
這些雜訊讓人疲憊
that noise is exhausting.
網路上分心，不只是意志力的問題
Losing focus online isn't just a willpower problem.
而是設計的問題
It's a design problem.
我們從一個瀏覽器小遊戲 Go/No-Go 開始
We started with a simple browser game called Go/No-Go.
從每一條滑鼠軌跡，算出十個特徵
From every mouse path, we extracted ten features,
像反應時間變異、方向變換、路徑效率
such as reaction-time variability, direction changes, and path efficiency.
合成注意力負荷分數，顯示在儀表板上
Together, they form an attention-load score on a live dashboard.
v0.1 能量測注意力
v0.1 could measure attention.
但只量測，還幫不上忙
But measuring isn't helping.
接著我們問：能不能在任何網頁上運作
Then we asked: could this work on any web page,
而不只在測驗裡？
not just inside a test?
於是我們把它做成 Chrome 擴充功能
So we rebuilt it as a Chrome extension.
保留滑鼠移動特徵
It keeps the movement features
再加上來回捲動等瀏覽訊號
and adds browsing signals, like back-and-forth scrolling.
而且只跟你自己的基準比較
And it compares you only with your own baseline,
從不跟別人比
never with anyone else.
程式模擬測試中，躁動的游標
In a scripted test, restless cursor movement
分數衝過 80、接近滿分
climbed past eighty, toward the top of the scale.
平穩的移動一直低於 20
Steady movement stayed below twenty.
這證明分數會隨動作變化
That shows the score reacts to movement.
還不能說明真人會怎麼反應
It doesn't yet show how real people respond.
分數持續偏高時，擴充功能不會接管
When your score stays high, the extension doesn't take over.
它只會問：安靜一點的頁面會有幫助嗎？
It simply asks: would a calmer page help?
你說好之前，什麼都不會改變
Nothing changes until you say yes.
專注模式先讓廣告淡出
Focus mode fades out the ads,
讓側欄和彈窗滑走
slides away sidebars and pop-ups,
降低彩度、停止動畫
softens the colors and freezes animations,
再把文字放大成單欄
then enlarges the text into one calm column.
閱讀尺或段落聚焦
A reading ruler, or paragraph focus,
讓你一次只看一行、一段
lets you take it one line, or one paragraph, at a time.
不需要鏡頭，也不需要額外硬體
It needs no camera and no extra hardware,
只用你本來就在用的滑鼠
just the mouse you already use.
一鍵就能還原原本的網頁
One click restores the original page,
資料也不會離開你的電腦
and your data never leaves your computer.
下一步，我們會請同學試用
Next, classmates will try it,
用他們的回饋調整權重
and their feedback will help us tune the weights.
NeuroAdaptive 不是醫療或診斷工具
NeuroAdaptive is not a medical or diagnostic tool.
這是讓網頁配合人的一小步
It's a small step toward a web that adapts to people,
而不是讓人去配合網頁
instead of people adapting to the web.
歡迎來攤位試玩
Come try it at our booth.
